slice: wave7 checked two-partition checkerboard parametric surface geometry
validation_scope: Fresh targeted/full three package validation, including external three_test scene3d integration. No use of wave6 checkpoint as evidence; no claim of a new whole-repository checkpoint.

api.signature: func CheckerboardSurface(uMin,uMax,vMin,vMax float64,uSteps,vSteps int,sample func(u,v float64)(geom.Vec3,error)) ([2]*Mesh,error)
api.partition: cell(i,j) belongs to group(i+j)%2; each cell has two real indexed triangles; no material/color bound into geometry
api.empty: Group1 nil only for1x1; skip nil when creating instances/tracks. All errors return [2]*Mesh{}.
api.normals_uv: Global area-weighted incident triangle normals before partition copies; exact shared positions/normals/global UV(i/uSteps,1-j/vSteps), independent group buffers; no periodic weld/pole or polygon repair.
api.sampling: Synchronous v-row/u-column order, exact endpoints, exactly once per node on success; no callback retained. Domain/count errors before callback. Error/nonfinite output stops at node; callback panics including nil translated without payload formatting; degeneracy/canceled normals after complete grid. Callback side effects/time/memory/Goexit/fatal termination not controlled.
api.ownership: Mutable independent Mesh buffers, no alias across groups/constructions; complete authoring before concurrent render. Existing scene3d.New makes immutable copied snapshots.

limits.scope: API and numerical/resource limits for wave7, not a previous integration checkpoint
limits.input_domains: strictly increasing finite endpoints/span and representably distinct axis nodes
limits.sampled_positions: finite components within +/-1e12; degenerate triangle and zero/canceled global normal sums rejected
limits.grouping: (uCell+vCell)%2; group1 nil only at1x1; all failures return two nil pointers
limits.normal_uv_policy: Full-grid area weighted smooth normals before copying; global UV=(i/uSteps,1-j/vSteps); no periodic seam weld or analytic derivative sampling.

api.unsupported: No decreasing/zero domains, collapsed poles, automatic periodic seam normals, material binding, n-color/VMobject/stroke/jagged/updater/full Surface parity. Folded/self-intersecting geometry is not globally detected or repaired.

reference.new_api_subset: two geometric material groups; no VMobject/stroke/default-style parity or matched Manim render claim
reference.oracle: Independent Go full-grid coordinate/normal and ray reference plus direct analytic plane cell classification; scene3d TRS and concurrent snapshot references; no reference runtime fallback
